$$
\text{Percentage Change} = \left( \frac{\text{New Value} - \text{Old Value}}{\text{Old Value}} \right) \times 100
$$

\text{Percentage Change} = \left( \frac{5,742 - 1,235}{1,235} \right) \times 100
$$

$$
5,742 - 1,235 = 4,507
$$

Divide by the old value:
$$
\frac{4,507}{1,235} \approx 3.647
$$

Multiply by 100:
$$
3.647 \times 100 \approx 364.7
$$

Final answer: 364.7
